relations.source_statement_summary: Aceh's own monopoly enforcement restricts VOC's pepper trade volume at Tiku to 800 bahar in late 1625.
relations.historical_reconstruction: Represents Tiku's early (pre-1656) status as a pepper-trade region administered under Aceh's own monopoly -- economic pressure, not a Tiku-actor dispute.
relations.theoretical_annotation: No Tiku local actor's own conduct is documented in this passage; the dispute runs between VOC and Aceh, with Tiku as the site, per the source's own framing.
relations.public_display_summary: In 1625, Aceh's monopoly enforcement restricted VOC's pepper trade at Tiku.
relations.notes: Subject is the monopoly-enforcement officials, not the Aceh court directly, per the Political Office guard. No Tiku-local actor is a party to this relation.

relations.source_statement_summary: The Aceh queen personally issues a toll-exemption reconfirmation for VOC shipping at Tiku (among 4 named ports), demonstrating her own claimed administrative jurisdiction over Tiku's toll policy.
relations.historical_reconstruction: Represents Aceh's 1641 toll-policy claim over Tiku as CLAIM only -- no documented local Tiku-based official is named as administering this, and effective local compliance is not evidenced either way.
relations.theoretical_annotation: The grant is issued directly by the Aceh crown, not through a documented local Tiku-based intermediary -- this partially, not fully, answers whether Tiku was under an Aceh-appointed official.
relations.public_display_summary: In 1641, Aceh's crown claimed authority over toll policy at Tiku.
relations.notes: RELATION_TYPE_FAILURE candidate: the underlying act is a toll EXEMPTION (Aceh releasing VOC from a toll), not toll COLLECTION -- Draft V2 has no dedicated 'grants trade access/exemption' relation type (GRANTS_TRADE_ACCESS_TO is not in the frozen MVP_CORE set). This relation represents the standing jurisdictional claim the exemption presupposes, not the exemption act itself; see TIKU_V3_ONTOLOGY_STRESS_TEST.csv for the disclosed gap.

vocabulary_notes.relation_type_restraint: No SECEDES_FROM, REBELS_AGAINST, SUBDUES, KILLS, PATRON_OF, CLIENT_OF, RESISTS, or CONTINUES_AS_SAME_ACTOR relation type was created, per the explicit hard rule. The 1662 secession is represented via SWITCHES_ALIGNMENT_TO + REQUESTS_PROTECTION_FROM; the 1740 killing via CONTESTS_SUCCESSION_WITH (the succession-relevant rivalry, not the killing act itself as a directed KILLS edge); the 1693-95 Sas killing via a standalone observation with no relation at all, since no actor/mechanism can responsibly be assigned.
vocabulary_notes.toll_exemption_relation_type_failure: The 1641 Aceh toll exemption for VOC shipping at Tiku could not be represented as its own directed relation without either inventing a new relation type (GRANTS_TRADE_ACCESS_TO, not in Draft V2's frozen MVP_CORE set) or misusing COLLECTS_TOLL_FROM to mean its own opposite (an exemption, not a collection). This artifact represents only the standing jurisdictional claim the exemption presupposes (CLAIMS_JURISDICTION_OVER), and logs the exemption-specific representational gap as RELATION_TYPE_FAILURE in the stress-test ledger.
vocabulary_notes.resistance_candidate_target_ambiguity: Draft V2's resistance_candidate field has no explicit target-actor sub-field. The 1662 PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED value is disambiguated via each relation's own notes as resistance-TO-ACEH specifically, even though the relation's OBJECT is VOC (the alignment destination). This is disclosed as a stress-test finding (candidate ANNOTATION_MODEL_FAILURE), not silently resolved by adding an undocumented field.
vocabulary_notes.mandate_status_continuity_status_disclos: As in the Koto Tangah V2 artifact, mandate_status/continuity_status/faction_status are NOT fields Draft V2's own Identity Rules (section 4) define. They are added here as descriptive bookkeeping fields only, per this task's own explicit instruction to test whether Koto Tangah's T-14 (ACTOR_IDENTITY_FAILURE) recurs -- it does, and is logged again here (see stress test), not silently patched by extending Draft V2's actual controlled vocabulary.
vocabulary_notes.patron_client_no_edge: patron_client_classification appears only as a relation-level field (values used: PATRON_CLIENT_NOT_TESTABLE, PATRON_CLIENT_CONTESTED for the 1684 pardon specifically). No PATRON_OF/CLIENT_OF edge exists anywhere in this artifact.
